paperTitle: LABORAL: A Transformational Game for Preventing Occupational Diseases via Leap Motion Hand Gesture Recognition
centralContribution: This work presents LABORAL, a transformational game developed in Unity using the Leap Motion sensor, designed to educate and train individuals, particularly computer users, in hand and wrist stretching exercises through gestural interactions to prevent occupational diseases like LER (Lesão por Esforço Repetitivo) and DORT (Distúrbio Osteomuscular Relacionado ao Trabalho). The game utilizes a sequence of 17 physiotherapist-defined hand poses, requiring players to sustain correct postures for 10 seconds via real-time gesture recognition, offering an engaging approach to upper limb health education and behavioral transformation.

elements.name: Paper Abstract
elements.description: The widespread informatization of workplaces leads individuals, especially IT professionals, to spend long periods performing repetitive computer movements, causing pain and impacting performance. This sedentary workload is a primary cause of occupational diseases such as LER (Repetitive Strain Injury) and DORT (Work-Related Musculoskeletal Disorder), which affect muscles, tendons, nerves, and ligaments, primarily in the upper limbs. While labor gymnastics is a proven preventive strategy, traditional methods often lack engagement. Gesture recognition sensors, like Leap Motion, are promising but face challenges in continuous, precise gesture identification, necessitating robust and engaging interactive applications for prevention.
elements.justification: This element provides the essential background, problem statement, and context for the entire paper, setting the stage for the proposed solution.

elements.name: LABORAL Game System
elements.description: LABORAL is a transformational game developed in Unity using the Leap Motion sensor to educate and train individuals in hand and wrist stretching exercises via gestural interactions. Its primary goal is to prevent occupational diseases like LER and DORT by guiding users through 17 physiotherapist-defined hand poses, requiring sustained correct postures for 10 seconds through real-time gesture recognition, promoting upper limb health and behavioral change.
elements.justification: This directly states the central innovation and the main purpose of the research presented in the paper.

elements.name: LABORAL Game Workflow Diagram
elements.description: A diagram outlining the various activities or flow within the LABORAL game, illustrating how health exercises are integrated into gameplay and the sequence of interactions.
elements.justification: This figure provides a crucial structural overview of the LABORAL game's internal logic and how the health exercises are orchestrated, making it the most important conceptual diagram.

elements.name: Physiotherapist-Defined Hand Poses
elements.description: Lists the 17 distinct hand poses defined by a physiotherapist, which form the core of the stretching exercises and the basis for gesture recognition within the LABORAL game.
elements.justification: This table is fundamental as it defines the specific physical actions and gestures that the game is built upon, directly supporting its health prevention goals.

elements.name: LABORAL Gameplay Screenshot
elements.description: A screenshot or photograph of the LABORAL game being played, illustrating its user interface and interactive elements, showing a user performing a hand pose over the Leap Motion sensor.
elements.justification: This image provides a concrete visual representation of the game in action, showcasing its interface and how users interact with the core functionality.

elements.name: Leap Motion Pose Recognition Times
elements.description: Shows the individual recognition times for various hand poses by the Leap Motion sensor across 15 repetitions, presented as median values, highlighting specific poses that were more challenging to recognize.
elements.justification: This table presents critical empirical data on the performance and limitations of the Leap Motion sensor in recognizing individual hand gestures, which is central to the game's functionality.

elements.name: Pose Sustenance Failure Analysis
elements.description: Details the total number of failures and the number of tests in which failures occurred for sustaining each hand pose for 10 seconds, identifying the poses most prone to interruptions.
elements.justification: This table provides crucial insights into the reliability and robustness of the gesture recognition system for sustained poses, which directly impacts the user experience and the effectiveness of the exercise.

elements.name: Continuous Exercise Sequence Performance
elements.description: Presents the total execution time and number of failures for five repetitions of each of the five continuous exercise sequences in LABORAL, detailing the performance of the integrated exercise routines.
elements.justification: This table evaluates the system's performance in a more realistic continuous usage scenario, showing how individual pose recognitions translate into complete exercise routines.

elements.name: Summary of Continuous Exercise Metrics
elements.description: Summarizes the average execution time, ideal sustenance and recognition times, the difference from the ideal, and total failures for each of the five continuous exercise sequences, providing an overall performance metric of the game's exercise flow.
elements.justification: This table offers an aggregated view of the system's performance across all defined exercise sequences, providing a concise summary of the overall efficacy and challenges.
